exposure: Oral progestin therapy (megestrol acetate or medroxyprogesterone acetate)
cohort: Six young patients (30-36 years old) diagnosed with grade 1 stage IA endometrial cancer who wished to preserve fertility were enrolled.
finding: All six patients achieved complete tumor remission after hysteroscopic resection and progestin therapy, with one patient subsequently achieving spontaneous pregnancy and delivery.
mod_finding: One patient became pregnant spontaneously and delivered a full-term healthy baby via cesarean section.
